{{Quote|Our centuries-old lineage within the Core has leant credence to newly minted currency, which represents the assests of the Separatist worlds.|[[Lo Vapeet]]|<ref name="Shadowfeed">{{InsiderCite|66|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:3:10 Edition}}</ref>}}
The '''CIS credit''' was the currency for many [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] worlds and introduced by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. The IGBC had signed a [[non-exclusivity pact]] with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, which allowed the Banking Clan to continue operations within [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] financial circles and bolster the value of the CIS credit. After the [[Battle of Bassadro]] the CIS credit held more than 50 percent of the value of a standard Republic [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and was the exclusive currency of hundreds of [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds.<ref name="Shadowfeed" />
